title: Shallow footing contact-pressure interaction
description: Reusable SVG rigid-footing component showing average and linearly varying soil contact pressure under vertical load and uniaxial moment, with an explicit middle-third/full-contact check.
learningObjectives: Compute average and edge contact pressures for a rectangular rigid footing under P and M.
Recognize when the linear full-contact pressure assumption predicts tension and must not be used as a soil contact solution.

verification.notes: Rigid-footing pressure equations and middle-third reference case reviewed; live browser/accessibility review pending.
